title: Figure 8: FDL-7 C/D hypersonic glider and blended body hypersonic cruiser rendering
description: Color rendering of two silver hypersonic aircraft on a beige background, labeled "FDL-7 C/D Hypersonic Glider" (upper left) and "Blended Body Hypersonic Cruiser" (lower right). Caption: "Figure 8. High-Performance Hypersonic Glide Aircraft. Rocket boost-glide and air-breather cruiser." Text notes both craft have hypersonic L/D ratios in excess of 2.7 and cross ranges over 4,500 nautical miles.
